info.title: Consola Cloud global API
info.description: The API every region shares: who is signed in, their workspaces and what each is connected to. Sign-in itself is Better Auth's, under /api/auth, and is not described here.

GitHubCallbackResult.description: How a Connect ended, as the callback names it in the web app’s `?github=`.

GitHubWebhookReceived.description: `delivered`: the workspace’s cell recorded the event. `pong`: GitHub’s ping, passed on to no cell.

Me.description: Who is signed in, and their session’s active workspace.

MyWorkspace.description: A workspace as one of its members sees it.

WorkspaceMember.description: A member of a workspace, as its other members see them.

InvalidWorkspace.description: Every problem, in the order the rules name them.

NewWorkspace.description: A name (trimmed, at most 64 characters), a slug of lowercase letters and digits with single dashes between (at most 48) and a region.

expiresAt.description: In whole seconds since the epoch.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the token is for: the one active when it was minted, which another tab may have switched since the page loaded.

region.description: The workspace's region, whose cell takes the token.

CellToken.description: The token the session's active workspace's cell trusts, for minutes.

canManage.description: Whether the person may connect and disconnect: an owner or admin.

configured.description: Whether this server has the GitHub App’s settings.

Connections.description: What the workspace is connected to.

settingsUrl.description: Where on GitHub its repositories are chosen, and it is uninstalled.

GitHubConnection.description: A GitHub App installation the workspace holds.

GitHubAccount.description: The GitHub account, an organisation or a person, the app is installed on.

GitHubRepositories.description: What GitHub says the installation covers now: its repositories, `gone` when GitHub no longer has the installation (uninstalled or suspended there), or `unavailable` when GitHub did not say. Asked of GitHub each time, never stored.

post.summary: Receive one of the GitHub App’s webhook deliveries
post.description: The GitHub App’s webhook URL. GitHub calls it, with no session and no Origin, so it is outside the origin check. The body is GitHub’s event payload as JSON, read as raw bytes and checked against `X-Hub-Signature-256` (HMAC-SHA256 under the app’s webhook secret, compared in constant time) before anything else is read; `X-GitHub-Event` names the event and `X-GitHub-Delivery` is GitHub’s id of the delivery, which it keeps when it sends a delivery again. The event is passed on, signed, to the cell of the workspace that holds its installation, which records each delivery once. Nothing of it is kept here.

400.description: Signed, but a header or the body is not what GitHub sends.

401.description: No `X-Hub-Signature-256`, or not GitHub’s signature over this body.

409.description: The workspace’s cell had this delivery already: sent again, or replayed. Nothing changed.

413.description: Over the 25 MB GitHub puts in a delivery at most.

422.description: Dropped: the event came through an installation no workspace holds, or through none.

502.description: The workspace’s cell did not take the event. GitHub’s Redeliver sends it again.

503.description: This server has no webhook secret (`GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET`), or no cell for the workspace’s region.

200.description: The person and their active workspace.

put.summary: Make one of my workspaces active

400.description: The body is not what the route takes.

403.description: The change did not come from the web app.

404.description: No workspace of the person’s has that id, whether or not one exists.

415.description: The body is not JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`).

get.summary: My active workspace's members, in the order they joined
get.description: Every member of the workspace may list them. A person is named by the global id a cell knows them by (`id`), so the web app can put a name to the ids a cell answers with.

403.description: The person is not in the workspace their session names, any more or ever.

409.description: The session has no active workspace.

get.summary: My workspaces, in the order I joined them

post.summary: Make a workspace, owned by me and active in my session

201.description: The workspace made, with the person as its owner.

400.description: The rules refuse the workspace, or the body is not JSON.

403.description: The change did not come from the web app.

409.description: A workspace in some region has that slug.

415.description: The body is not JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`).

post.summary: Mint a token for my session's active workspace
post.description: Nothing in the request names the workspace or the role: both are read from the database as the token is minted. No cache keeps the answer (`Cache-Control: no-store`).

200.description: The token, and when it stops being valid.

403.description: The person is not in the workspace their session names, or the request did not come from the web app.

409.description: The session has no active workspace.

get.summary: The public keys a cell checks cell tokens with
get.description: A JSON Web Key Set (RFC 7517). Reading it needs no sign-in.

get.summary: What my session's active workspace is connected to
get.description: Any member may read it; `canManage` says whether they may change it.

403.description: The person is not in the workspace their session names.

409.description: The session has no active workspace.

post.summary: Start connecting GitHub to my active workspace
post.description: The address on GitHub that installs the app, carrying a state signed for this session. Only an owner or admin may. No cache keeps the answer (`Cache-Control: no-store`).

403.description: The person is not in the workspace, is not an owner or admin of it, or the request did not come from the web app.

409.description: The session has no active workspace.

503.description: This server has no GitHub App settings.

get.summary: Where GitHub sends a person back after installing the app
get.description: The GitHub App’s callback URL, reached by a browser redirect from GitHub with `state`, `code`, `installation_id`, `setup_action` or `error`. It never answers JSON: it always redirects to the web app’s Settings, on its Connections page, with how the Connect ended in `?github=`: one of `connected`, `already_connected`, `requested`, `cancelled`, `bad_state`, `expired`, `not_allowed`, `code_refused`, `not_installer`, `not_account_admin`, `taken`, `invalid`, `unavailable`, `not_configured`, `signed_out`.

delete.summary: Disconnect a GitHub installation from my active workspace
delete.description: Removes the workspace’s record. The app stays installed on GitHub until someone uninstalls it there (`settingsUrl`). Only an owner or admin may.

schema.description: The installation’s id on GitHub, a positive whole number.

parameters.description: The installation’s id on GitHub, a positive whole number.
parameters.name: installationId

400.description: The id is not a GitHub id.

403.description: The person is not in the workspace, is not an owner or admin of it, or the request did not come from the web app.

404.description: The workspace holds no installation with that id, whether or not another does.

409.description: The session has no active workspace.

get.summary: Whether the service can reach its database
